title: Paradise X #12 Marvel Comics 2003 Final Issue Alex Ross Krueger Braithwaite
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Paradise X #12 (2003), Marvel Comics - the final issue of the series and the conclusion of the Earth X / Universe X / Paradise X saga. Written by Jim Krueger with Alex Ross, art by Doug Braithwaite and Bill Reinhold, painted cover featuring the Thing.

Back cover: X2 Wolverine's Revenge video game ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
